content.text: {"core": "Reciprocity converts holding into exchange: what one being keeps returns to circulation between beings. At Source, it operates on the threshold where the sequence takes its first supply — the intake gate itself. Balanced, it meets each arrival with an answering release, so nothing enters as pure taking and the ingress stays a two-way current feeding what follows.", "sheetLine": "What comes in is answered by what goes out; the gate flows both ways."}
